note_en: The pattern 一…就… means "as soon as… then…" and appears again and again here: 他一进食堂就开始讲笑话 "the moment he walks into the cafeteria, he starts cracking jokes," 她一看书就犯困 "she gets sleepy as soon as she opens a book." Note that both markers come after the subject, right before the verbs, not at the start of the clause like English "as soon as."
